title: Blind Match
subtitle: Find out if you both carry a change in the same gene, without either of you seeing the other's result.
draftNote: Draft wording, pending review by a counsellor.

start.title: Check together
start.body: One of you shows a code and the other scans it. Each of you agrees on your own phone. Then you both see one answer.
start.nameLabel: Show my first name to the other person

points.private: You won't see their result, and they won't see yours.
points.reveals: The answer still tells you something about each other. If it says you share a change, you'll both know the other carries a change in at least one gene you also carry. If you know your own result, you may be able to work out which one.
points.coverage: If it says no shared change, it covers only the conditions you were both screened for.
points.stop: You can stop at any time before the answer appears.
points.choice: This is information, not advice about marriage. What you do with it is your choice.
points.screen: Your answer appears on your own screen. You choose who else sees it.

code.title: Your code
code.body: Ask the other person to scan this with their phone, or to type the code in GeneBridge.
code.qrLabel: QR code for joining this Blind Match
code.expired: This code has expired. Start again for a new one.
code.shareText: Join my GeneBridge Blind Match with this link.

join.title: Join with a code
join.label: Code
join.notFound: That code didn't work. It may have expired or already been used. Check it, or ask for a new one.
join.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait an hour and try again.

scanner.label: Camera view for scanning a Blind Match code
scanner.hint: Point your camera at the QR code on the other person's screen.

agree.title: Do you agree to check together?
agree.otherAgreed: {name} agreed. Tap I agree to see your answer.
agree.waitingJoin: {name} joined. Read the points above, then agree.
agree.understand: I’ve read the points above and understand what the answer can tell us.

cancelled.title: This check was stopped
cancelled.body: No answer was worked out, and nothing was saved about either of you.

shared.title: You share a change in the same gene
shared.body: For at least one condition, you each carry a change in the same gene. Most people who carry one are healthy. Neither of you has been shown the other's result. A genetic counsellor can explain what this means for any future pregnancy and what options exist.

none.title: No shared change found
none.body: You were both screened for {count, plural, one {# of the same conditions} other {# of the same conditions}}, and you don't both carry a change in any of them. This isn't a guarantee: it covers only these conditions, and only these screening tests.

not_comparable.title: We couldn't compare your results
not_comparable.body: None of the conditions Blind Match checks were on both of your screening reports, so there is nothing to compare. A genetic counsellor can tell you what other screening is available.

answer.privateNote: Neither of you has been shown the other's result.
answer.notCertificate: Covers {count, plural, one {# condition} other {# conditions}} only. Not a medical certificate.
answer.notCoveredBody: Blind Match compares only conditions where a child is affected when both parents carry a change (recessive conditions), and only those on both of your reports. It doesn't cover dominant or X-linked conditions, conditions only one of you was screened for, or anything a screening panel can't detect.

reveal.body: The condition is shown only if you both tap this. The other person won't know whether you tapped.
reveal.waiting: You asked to see it. It will appear if the other person asks too.
reveal.title: The shared condition

flagged.title: Talk to a counsellor first
flagged.body: Part of your result needs a genetic counsellor to look at it with you, so Blind Match isn't available.

no_result.title: Blind Match needs a screening result
no_result.body: It compares screening results, so you need yours in GeneBridge first. This isn't a diagnosis: only a test can tell you whether you carry a change.

unverified.title: Blind Match needs a confirmed result
unverified.body: It uses results from your screening centre only. Connect your report with its reference code to confirm it.

limit.title: You've used Blind Match 3 times this month
limit.body: To protect everyone's privacy, each person can check up to 3 times in 30 days. You can still talk to a counsellor at any time.

history.title: Your recent answers
history.body: Kept for 7 days, then deleted. Never which condition.

error: That didn't work. Please try again.

coupleCard.title: Not ready to link accounts?
coupleCard.body: Check together first with Blind Match: one answer, and neither of you sees the other's result.

s1.title: Connect
s1.body: One of you shows a code. The other scans it or types it in.

s2.title: Both agree
s2.body: Each of you reads what the answer can tell you, and agrees on your own phone.

s3.title: One answer
s3.body: You both see the same answer. Neither of you sees the other’s result.

unavailable.title: Blind Match isn’t switched on yet
unavailable.body: It needs a database update before it can be used. Please try again later.
